limits.item: The actual tils reader presents PD-L1 SP142 as its dedicated readout; cold-vs-hot presents STK11/KEAP1 lung biomarker. Both route to a different subject. Product mapping is unchanged and needs owner review.
Independent, expert, owner, learner, language and main/live acceptance are zero; exact source/field entailment remains coordinator judgment.

Twelve fresh complete abstracts, seven targeted body paragraphs, one caption, one guidance table page, two NCI records, two HGNC joins and seven selected UniProt comment blocks. No whole paper, whole reference entry or source-study figure approval.

Two Crossref requests returned 429; five Europe PMC article-body requests returned 500. Four BioC/efetch routes returned nonarticle stubs; legal alternate captures were used only when actual text was verified. No challenge bypass.

S07, E02 and A06 retain explicit drawing-context/bookkeeping/map conventions, with represented teaching invariants and no additional science credit. Exact symbolic counts/layout are not silently claimed to be canonical sentences.

Historical PASS, prospective owner states, stage/preimage/private hashes, unknown original creator and focus-return-to-BODY stay at their stated scope. Unmatched bounded hashes are not automatically failures.

Ten Mermaid version instances were read as source, not rendered. Native whole views do not prove PNG exact palette-only identity, hosted browser/hydration, mobile, quantitative contrast or accessibility acceptance.
All unrelated ordinary/adjacent/schema/literature gaps and six unapplied immunopeptidome requirements remain; the P44 matrix proposal remains open.

NCI defines abscopal for local therapy such as radiation. The selected art and field notes are radiation-specific, not a universal exclusivity claim. Shared-guide absolute checkpoint and unselected clinical clauses are not newly certified.

Eighty-one summary slots have thirty existing texts and fifty-one English fallbacks. The pre-label-change state is explicitly reconstructed from unchanged inputs; no text, review mark or long cache changes, and no language acceptance is claimed.
